notes:
Pass on the fake backend (gate exit 0): evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware run was made, and no human review or hardware test is claimed. At R1 the loader only refuses an unreviewed model-written hardware backend at R2 or R3; no protection beyond that is claimed.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card says decision family-config, family scpi and helper ScpiDriver, but the upstream interface is a PyVisa object whose per-channel requests are assembled from parts (SENS:<function>:..., TRIG:SIGN, FETCH?) and whose measurement channels sit behind the pymeasure container (instruments/keithley2000_multimeter.py:69-90 and 639-659). A SCPI command table cannot express that channel API, so this package is a direct Driver over the card's entry symbol instruments.keithley2000_multimeter:Keithley2000Multimeter (line 639) with native.py. The card's other entry symbols also exist (QxfordPS120 line 175, QxfordIPS line 224, QxfordILM line 48, AdwinPro2DaqChannel line 52); this package drives the Keithley 2000 because its three channels map to cap.measure.voltage.v1, cap.measure.current.v1 and cap.measure.resistance.v1. The card's candidate cap.sensing.read.v1 lists sensor kinds only and does not bind instrument.dmm.

Scope: reads identification, voltage_dc, current_dc, resistance and voltage_range; actions cap.measure.voltage.v1, cap.measure.current.v1 and cap.measure.resistance.v1; one write, voltage_range (0 to 1010 V, instruments/keithley2000_multimeter.py:236-245); @estop and @reset both run the upstream reset (*RST, *CLS). The action inputs channel, range_v and range_a are bounded by the channel names and range setters at lines 653, 656, 659 and 236-245 and 265-274; no bound is operator_required, so site-limits.example.json is absent. dc=false and four_wire=true are refused with MHS.DEVICE.PRECONDITION_UNMET because the clone defines only VOLT:DC and two-wire RES.

Warnings: G4 is clean. G7.MAYBE_ABSENT is reported for channels only: it is the pymeasure Instrument container accessor (case.py:447-453) inherited through the external PyVisaInstrument base, which the gate's AST cannot follow. The name occurs in the clone, the driver and the fake use it, and facts.md records it. No other warning was reported.

Fixtures: fixtures/conformance.json is package test data with the channel names the upstream __init__ creates; it keeps the conformance suite from sending the catalogue's generic ch1 example to actions that accept only their real channel. The clone ships no simulator, mock or transcript (the card's mock_strategy preferred transcript), so fake.py is an in-memory stand-in; every number in it is marked # placeholder and is not a Fact or a Limit.

NOT COVERED: the hardware backend (native.py) was never imported or run and no hardware was attached; the upstream trigger, buffer, display, format, defaults and integration-time write paths are not bound; the current and resistance range writes are not exposed as state writes (only the voltage range is); the measurements return one sample, not the buffered trace; AC voltage and four-wire resistance are refused rather than implemented. No hardware e-stop is claimed; the e-stop is the native reset. driver.lock.json reviewed_by stays null.
